title: mathclass.test.ts: fix it.todo — Math.abs(-5) emits ActionCallMethod not ActionGetMember
description: packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/mathclass.test.ts line 46 has: it.todo('Math.abs(-5) emits ActionGetMember (0x4e) for abs on Math'). This description is incorrect. The compiler's compileCallExpr path (lines 1806-1823) handles MemberExpr callees by emitting ActionGetVariable for the object (Math) + ActionCallMethod (0x52) with the method name on the stack. ActionGetMember (0x4e) is NOT emitted for a method call — it is only emitted for property reads (compileMemberExpr). The it.todo needs to be replaced with a passing test asserting: (1) Math.abs(-5) emits ActionCallMethod (0x52), and (2) Math.abs(-5) does NOT emit ActionGetMember (0x4e) for the method dispatch. The existing Math.PI test at line 114 already confirms ActionGetMember IS emitted for property reads, which is the correct counterpart.
